systems.name: text-reasoning
systems.capability: text: one plain sentence for each story
systems.why: Writing a sentence that says what each story is about is a judgment, which is what a text model is for.

kind.why: A short program with one judgment in it: read the top stories, write a sentence for each, hand back the digest. A harness reading skills carries it.

speed.why: One read of the top stories and one model call.

data.limit: holds the stories only for the job and keeps nothing between jobs
data.why: Nothing in the statement asks for a history.

trust.limit: takes jobs only from its owner
trust.why: The digest is for the owner.

egress.why: To read the current top stories. It needs no key

formats.convention: a header `read_at, stories`, then `## Digest` with one bullet per story

settings.name: stories_to_read
settings.label: Stories to read
settings.about: How many top stories to read from Hacker News.
settings.why: How far down the list to read is the owner's habit; thirty is a morning's front page.

settings.name: digest_size
settings.label: Digest size
settings.about: How many stories to put in the digest.
settings.why: Five stories is a short read.

decisions.decided: Hand the digest back as Markdown
decisions.why: A person reads it; JSON would be a page of brackets.
decisions.weighed: JSON with a vendor kind, which only code would read
decisions.follows: The convention is a header and one fixed heading.
